title: More Capable, Less Faithful: A Multilingual Analysis of Mathematical (Un)Solvability Detection in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Solvability detection is one of the most challenging aspects of mathematical reasoning for Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior work has studied this capability extensively, these analyses have been limited to English. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multilingual failures arise from differences in internal Solvability Belief or from language-dependent failures to express it. To address this gap, we introduce the first multilingual benchmark of paired solvable and unsolvable mathematical problems, extending ReliableMath to French and Greek. translated_title: 更强大却更不忠实：大语言模型数学（不）可解性检测的多语言分析
translated_abstract: 可解性检测是大语言模型数学推理中最具挑战性的方面之一。尽管先前的工作已对这一能力进行了广泛研究，但这些分析仅限于英语。因此，多语言场景下的失败究竟源于内部可解性信念的差异，还是源于表达该信念时依赖语言的失败，目前尚不清楚。为填补这一空白，我们引入了首个由成对可解与不可解数学问题组成的多语言基准，将 ReliableMath 扩展至法语和希腊语。基于此，我们训练了预测可解性信念的多语言探针，并从行为、表征和忠实度三个角度分析了最先进大语言模型的可解性检测能力。我们发现，可解性信念被编码为一种基本通用、与语言无关的特征，而像英语这类高资源语言，尽管在数学推理上表现更强……
tldr: 该研究首次构建了多语言数学可解性检测基准，发现大语言模型内部的可解性信念是语言无关的通用特征，但能力更强的模型对其内部信念的忠实度反而更低。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the first multilingual benchmark for mathematical solvability detection in LLMs, finding that solvability belief is encoded as a largely universal, language-agnostic feature, while more capable models are less faithful to their internal beliefs.
